Rust Programming Language

Rust is a systems programming language designed for safety, concurrency, and performance.
Rust provides memory safety without requiring a garbage collector.
Rust uses an ownership system to determine when memory should be allocated and released.
Every value in Rust has an owner.
Borrowing allows code to access values through references without transferring ownership.
Rust's compiler checks ownership and borrowing rules at compile time.

Rust is frequently used for operating systems, embedded software, network services, WebAssembly applications, and performance-sensitive software.

Go Programming Language

Go is a statically typed programming language originally developed at Google.
Go provides lightweight concurrent execution through goroutines.
Goroutines are managed by the Go runtime and are multiplexed onto operating system threads.
Channels allow goroutines to communicate and synchronize with one another.
Go includes automatic garbage collection.
Go interfaces provide a mechanism for polymorphism without requiring traditional class inheritance.

The Go runtime contains a scheduler responsible for scheduling goroutines onto available operating system threads.

Acme Technologies Employee Handbook

Acme Technologies provides employees with 24 paid leave days every year.
Employees may carry forward a maximum of 10 unused leave days into the next year.
Employees receive health insurance coverage for themselves, their spouse, and up to two children.
Remote employees receive an annual home-office allowance of 30,000 rupees.
Employees receive a learning and development allowance of 50,000 rupees per year for approved technical courses, certifications, books,

velopment allowance of 50,000 rupees per year for approved technical courses, certifications, books, and conferences.
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week.
The normal working hours are from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM Monday through Friday.
Employees completing five years of continuous service receive an additional five days of paid leave per year.
